description: This file '464xlat.sh' sets up and tears down a 464xlat configuration for IPv6 translation in a network environment. It contains functions to initialize configuration, setup, and teardown of the protocol, including network rules and routing adjustments.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv6 translation protocol, configuring routing, firewall, and dependency rules based on provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up resources and network rules associated with the IPv6 translation protocol for a given configuration.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration variables for the protocol, defining which parameters can be set.
